scope: User-requested multi-view retrieval ablation; development only
frozen_settings: Same32-chunk native trajectory, source/checkpoint, sampler, seed,18 attended latent frames,6 initial sinks,16-frame CPU archive6..21, virtual key positions
attention_tradeoff: Four retrieved frames leave8 recent/current frames. Eight retrieved frames leave4 current frames. More historical views replace recency at constant attention tokens; GPU stored retrieval and transfer cost can still increase.
diversity_rule: Greedy pose-overlap ranking with at least15-degree angular or2-unit positional separation between selected views. Do not pad with duplicates. Retrieval activates only with at least4 available selected frames; actual count and retained tail are recorded.
hardware: All four runs useH100, Torch2.6/CUDA12.4, with the completed text encoder moved toCPU. Rerun the4-nearest control on this hardware rather than presuming equivalence to H200.
primary_evaluation: Complete-video blinded comparison against the4-nearest reference, tracking return landmark identity, continuity and actual camera motion. Also report endpoint DINO/PSNR, pixel-identical prefix, actual view counts, latency and GPU/CPU memory.
selection_policy: Report all four outcomes. No candidate selected on held-out scenes. Validate any promising read-count/selection change on a new image before recommending it.
runtime_retry: Eight-view diverse run reached the first return chunk then failed allocating an854MiB VAE buffer with800MiB free and5.86GiB reserved-but-unused. Preserve it and retry only this variant with expandable CUDA allocator segments. This changes memory allocation, not weights, inputs, cache content or view selection. Verify its already-generated raw-pixel prefix against the failed attempt before scoring.
